name: Daniel Osei
headline: Python / Django Developer
summary: Former head of mathematics who retrained as a developer in 2023. Two and a half years shipping Django features for education and fintech products, with a teacher's habit of explaining things clearly.

experience.title: Django Developer
bullets: Build accounting integrations in Django REST Framework that sync 50,000 invoices a month with three banking partners.
Wrote PostgreSQL reporting views that replaced a fragile spreadsheet export used by the finance team.
Added pytest fixtures and factory data that cut the test suite runtime from 14 to 5 minutes.
Packaged the service with Docker so local and pipeline environments match.

experience.title: Junior Developer
bullets: Built teacher-facing Django pages for setting and marking homework, used in 40 schools.
Wrote Python scripts that import pupil rosters from school information systems each night.
Fixed accessibility issues in the HTML and CSS templates, reaching WCAG AA on the core flows.

experience.title: Head of Mathematics
bullets: Led a department of seven teachers and raised the GCSE maths pass rate from 68% to 81% in three years.
Built Excel trackers for pupil progress that flagged students for intervention every half term.
Redesigned the Key Stage 4 scheme of work around retrieval practice and weekly low-stakes quizzes.

experience.title: Mathematics Teacher
bullets: Taught mathematics to around 180 students a year across Years 7 to 13.
Kept department assessment data in Excel and produced termly progress reports for parents.
Ran the after-school maths club and coached the regional team for the UK Maths Challenge.
